## Services

- [Branding & Identity](https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/services/branding-identity) — logo, colour, type and voice. Starting from ₹50,000.
- [Web Design & Development](https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/services/web-design-development) — fast, accessible, mobile-first websites. Starting from ₹80,000.
- [Motion Graphics & Video](https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/services/motion-graphics-video) — brand films, reels and animation. Starting from ₹60,000.

## Process

Discover → Define & Concept → Create → Refine → Deliver, over 6 weeks, with support from week 7. See the full week-by-week timeline at [Process](https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/process).
